metadata.title: 90s Monochrome Portrait with Outlined Display Type

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast monochrome portrait featuring a subject with intricate braided hair, anchored by oversized outlined sans-serif typography and a singular red accent on the lips.
excludeWhen: minimalist or thin typography is requested

recipe.visualDefinition: A close-up, high-contrast black and white portrait of a woman with long, thin braids. The composition is dominated by a large, white-outlined sans-serif title at the top that overlaps the subject's hair. The only color in the image is a vibrant, saturated red on the subject's lips and a small secondary text line.
coreVisualRelationships: The white outlined text creates a frame-like header over the dark hair.
The red lips provide a focal point that breaks the monochrome palette.
The texture of the braids contrasts with the smooth skin and flat graphic text.
The subject's direct gaze establishes an intimate connection with the viewer.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is centered, filling the lower two-thirds of the frame from the shoulders up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes and the red lips act as the primary and secondary anchors.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: From the large outlined header down to the eyes, then to the red lips, following the vertical lines of the braids.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the subject and typography fill the majority of the square frame.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast in the greyscale; extremely high saturation in the red accent.
paletteRestrictions: No other colors besides red and greyscale

letterConstructionRules: Uniform stroke weight for the outline
Transparent counters/fills to show the background
characterSpecificRedesigns: A and R characters feature sharp, geometric apexes
P and R have large, open bowls
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A massive, hollow geometric sans-serif paired with a small, delicate red serif italic for contrast in scale and color.

avoid: Script fonts for the main title

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric skeleton and wide stance.
Provides the correct 90s geometric feel with tight kerning potential.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-contrast black and white portrait of a woman with long, thin braids looking directly at the camera. The background should be a neutral grey. Apply a vibrant, saturated red color only to the lips.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, white-outlined geometric sans-serif title across the top, overlapping the hair. Layer a smaller, red italic serif subtitle directly over the center of the main title.

verificationChecks: Is the image monochrome except for the red accents?
Is the main title outline-only with no fill?
Does the text overlap the subject's hair?
Is the hair texture clearly defined in braids?

mustRedesign: Do not use the specific name 'Patra'
Do not use the specific phrase 'Scent of Attraction'
Avoid exact replication of the subject's facial features

mustAchieve: Clean, vector-like quality to the text outlines
avoid: Color bleeding from the red lips into the skin

postGenerationChecks: Check that the red subtitle is legible against the white outlines.
Ensure the monochrome skin tones have a smooth gradient.
Verify the outlined text is perfectly centered.
Confirm no other colors appear in the background or clothing.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast monochrome portrait + braided texture + oversized white outline sans-serif + singular red focal point.
